description: This file defines the MultiRegionClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages multiple regional clients for AWS services. It includes methods for configuring regions, creating commands, managing client pools, and handling custom handlers, enabling multi-region interactions.

classes.name: MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A client class that manages multiple regional AWS service clients, allowing operations across different AWS regions with shared configuration and support for custom handlers.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns default configuration arguments for the client, including a client factory and partition configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultiRegionClient with specified configuration, setting up handler list, client factory, partition, and other arguments.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region the client is configured to connect to.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified operation name and arguments.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options or the entire configuration array.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the client.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list configured for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API description associated with the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL the client is configured to use.

methods.name: useCustomHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom handler to be used in command execution.

methods.name: isUseCustomHandler
methods.description: Checks if a custom handler has been set.

methods.name: getClientFromPool
methods.description: Retrieves a regional client from the internal pool or creates it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses the class name to determine the service name.

methods.name: getRegionFromArgs
methods.description: Determines the region to use based on arguments or default configuration.
